# My GEO Check

> My GEO Check analyses Shopify product pages for AI search visibility. It checks whether an AI assistant can read, describe and recommend a product, and returns a scored report with the specific fixes, ranked by impact.

Built and operated by Luo Xin, who has worked in website SEO since 2003. Operated from Yuci District, Jinzhong City, Shanxi Province, China. Contact: hello@mygeocheck.com

## What it does

- Reads a product page and generates the seven buyer questions an AI assistant typically receives for that product type
- Scores how well the page answers each question (high / medium / low), with the reason quoted from the page
- Produces three ranked diagnoses and a concrete, paste-ready fix for each
- Scans a whole Shopify catalogue (up to 200 products) against nine deterministic signals, without calling a model
- Re-checks the same questions later so a merchant can see whether a change moved anything

## What it does not do

- It does not query ChatGPT, Perplexity or Google and report what they said. No citation or competitor data comes from a live AI answer.
- It does not guarantee rankings, citations or recommendations in any AI product.
- AI answers vary by day, location and model version. A score is a reading at a point in time, not a verdict.

## Pages

- [Home](https://mygeocheck.com/): what the product does, pricing, and a free scan entry point
- [Store scan](https://mygeocheck.com/scan): enter a store domain or a product URL; scans a catalogue or analyses one product
- [Single product check](https://mygeocheck.com/check): the analysis tool itself
- [Methodology](https://mygeocheck.com/methodology): exactly what is measured, how the score is computed, and what the score cannot tell you
- [Pricing](https://mygeocheck.com/#pricing): free scan, $29 one-off report, $49 per month
- [About](https://mygeocheck.com/about): who operates the site
- [Refund policy](https://mygeocheck.com/refund-policy): 7-day money-back guarantee
- [Blog](https://mygeocheck.com/blog): research-backed articles on AI search for Shopify merchants

## Key facts

- Free tier: one catalogue scan (up to 200 products) and one deep product analysis per month
- $29 one-off: three deep product analyses, no auto-renewal
- $49 per month: 20 deep analyses per month, with re-checks on day 2, 7, 14 and 30
- Payments processed by Creem. Card, Apple Pay and Google Pay.
- The scoring model is a language model reading the page. The catalogue scan is deterministic rules only.
